P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait is used as a dominant human anchor anywhere on the page; the layout is entirely text and data-driven.

P05.rationale: The client sidebar (Conesso GmbH) contains only a text block and logo area with no portrait image of the client at any size.

P07.rationale: A testimonial quote block is present at the bottom of the right column, but there is no press/logo wall, rating cards, or review grid — only a single pull-quote.

P10.rationale: A faint ghost numeral '4' appears in the upper-right area of the headline zone, but it is small and subtle rather than a strongly oversized decorative typographic element; the quote glyph is present but modest.

P11.rationale: Three bold before/after metric statements ('von 30 auf 2 Minuten', etc.) are present as typographic callouts, but there are no actual charts, graphs, or cost-math visualisations — just styled text figures.

P12.rationale: The layout has a clear two-column structure with reasonable content density in the left column, but the right column has large empty white gaps between the metric callouts and the testimonial, leaving the page feeling under-filled.

P13.rationale: The background is entirely flat white with no texture, atmospheric treatment, or visual depth applied anywhere on the page.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so this criterion is not applicable; score reflects absence of the device.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: There are no photos at all, so stock imagery is not an issue, but the QR code and generic metric callouts give a somewhat template-like, non-specific feel.

N08.rationale: The right column has a large empty white region between the client info block and the metric callouts, and another gap before the testimonial, creating noticeable dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo anywhere on the page, so there is no scrim or legibility issue to penalise.
